features.name: Both-ways money collection
features.description: Wild pairs on either side collect connected money symbols.

features.name: Boost and Respin Wilds

features.name: Retriggering free spins
features.description: Every third wild pair adds four spins.

review:
Wild Wild Joker pays both left to right and right to left. If wilds land on reels one and two with money symbols on reels 3–5 (or the mirror image), the values of all connected money symbols are won.

Wilds on reels one and five can randomly turn into Boost Wilds, which increase visible money values, or Respin Wilds, which respin every reel without a wild. A pair of wilds plus a Free Spins symbol on reel three starts eight free spins, and every third pair of wilds retriggers four more spins, up to four times. Super Free Spins are also available. The in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.49%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
